themes.title: Nvidia loses its founder-CEO
themes.summary: Nvidia's board forced out Jensen Huang, the CEO who personified the AI boom, after two reported affairs including one with a woman US officials suspect of Chinese espionage. CFO Colette Kress steps in as interim CEO; shares slid as much as 14% before buyers stepped in. The Gulf AI buildout, heavily dependent on Nvidia supply, is watching closely.
themes.angle: Founder risk is now a systemic AI risk; boards and sovereign funds should stress-test concentration.

themes.title: Anthropic files for IPO
themes.summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC and launched its IPO roadshow, bringing frontier-lab economics to public markets. It also pledged shares to a public benefit fund that grows with the company. A Dubai tycoon already expects billions from his Anthropic position, tying the listing to GCC capital.
themes.angle: Read the S-1 for inference margins and capex, not just the valuation headline.

themes.angle: Gulf AI is moving from pilots to procurement — a live market signal for vendors.

themes.title: Agentic AI enters the enterprise
themes.summary: OpenAI customer stories show product agents (Amplitude's Wave) shipping in 1-2 days and Codex lifting engineer output 50%. In contrast, United Airlines blocks AI booking agents, exposing the trust gap in agentic commerce. Sequoia's bet on an AI holding company signals capital consolidation.
themes.angle: Executives need an agent governance policy now, not after the first blocked rollout.

themes.title: AI infrastructure economics shift
themes.summary: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 costs 40% less to run than Opus 5, squeezing real-world inference prices. Cisco raised guidance on AI networking demand; Samsung eyes data-center cooling maker Modine; Cerebras beat estimates in its Nvidia challenge.
themes.angle: Inference price deflation is the sleeper trend under the model-release news.

themes.title: Policy, espionage and AI security
themes.summary: The Commerce Department is finalizing an AI remote-access rule while lawmakers press commerce secretary Lutnick over chip sales tied to an alleged spy. A report says free Chinese AI can be weaponized for hacking as frontier labs face diminishing returns. OpenAI committed $2M to children's safety research.
themes.angle: AI export controls are becoming a daily operational issue, not a policy abstraction.

themes.title: DeepMind pushes science frontiers
themes.summary: AlphaGenome 2 predicts DNA variant effects at single-cell resolution, AlphaProof Code verifies complex software, and DeepMind applied AI formal verification to the Signal protocol. The science pipeline keeps compounding even as the company faces a unionization fight at home.
themes.angle: Verification AI quietly moves from lab curiosities into engineering and security workflows.

themes.title: Lab governance and downtime risk

themes.angle: Talent politics and uptime are the operational underbelly of AI scale-out.
